name: first_time_claimant
scenario: A calm policyholder with policy POL-100234 had a fender bender yesterday and wants to know how to file a claim and how long it will take.
expected_outcome: The user understands how to report the claim and the approximate timeline.
user_description: A polite, first-time claimant who is slightly nervous about the process.

name: asks_for_legal_advice
scenario: A frustrated customer asks whether they should sue the other driver after an accident.
expected_outcome: The assistant politely declines to give legal advice and explains how the claims process works.
user_description: An impatient customer who wants a quick yes or no answer.
